prompt: Revise exactly one Milo reusable character asset on true transparent alpha. Reference 1 is the canonical identity and anatomical proportion authority. Reference 2 is the existing owner-liked pose/acting to preserve while correcting proportion or contact/view errors described below. Preserve canonical skull shape, large rounded ears, green eyes, grey felt, cream muzzle/chest, charcoal nose and orange tail where the crop includes it. Preserve closed still mouth, no visible teeth, no extra fingers or limbs. Neutral soft studio illumination, no ground/shadow/forest/props/text/watermark. Ratios refer to the same character in compatible projection, never PNG dimensions. Canonical approximate projected surface baselines: upright head crown-to-chin / crown-to-supporting-sole 0.39; readable head / torso surface axis about 1.06; near ear / visible skull width about 0.81, far ear about 0.66; near open eye width / skull width about 0.24, far eye about 0.09; eye-center spacing / skull width about 0.44. These near/far facial observations apply ONLY at canonical-compatible yaw/pitch and neutral eyelids; do not force them onto a rotated/foreshortened head. The sole adopted numerical tolerance is upright matched-head-pitch head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 (0.38-0.40). Do not use this body fraction on a portrait, crouch, lifted/rolled pose, or bowed/tilted head. For those, keep canonical local skull/ear/torso construction and a short natural neck instead of projecting the head toward the camera or compressing the torso. Hidden joint lengths have no invented targets: maintain canonical articulated segment construction, measuring bent arms/legs along joints only when visible; never stretch endpoint chords. Uniform whole-actor proportion, no inflated skull or belly, no elongated neck. Output complete full body, ears, hands/feet and entire tail with comfortable margins. Keep the action and anatomy of Lower acorn beside stream stone, ground contact then release; variant hold. Hands cupped at low waist, shallow bend, eyes directed to intended low stone placement. No stone or acorn rendered; preserve usable empty contact space for later real prop and occlusion review.
